caption: The drawing depicts a standing human figure positioned vertically on a rectangular section of wood. The person is dressed in a floor-length black robe with long sleeves, and the hands and face are visible. The figure's head is encircled by a yellow halo with a red border, and the individual has long, dark hair falling to the shoulders. In the right hand, the person holds a dark-colored cross, while the left hand is raised to the chest. The background is filled with shades of yellow, orange, and light brown, blended together, and there are two sections with darker shading on either side of the lower half of the figure. In the upper part of the drawing, a draped green and black striped curtain is visible above the figure’s head. The wood itself is present as the border, showing natural brown edges, with some irregularities and nail holes at the top.
title: Retablo
